derived.description: One Million Eau de Toilette is a fresh and spicy fragrance for men with notes of amber, leather, and tangerine. It defies all the rules and upsets the codes while adding a touch of irresistible seduction. It contains head-turning aromas to suit a man with rebellious charm. One Million. You can be a bad boy, so long as you're a gentleman at all times. Never take orders, create your own rules. This fragrance contains more detailed notes including Frosted Grapefruit, Blood Mandarin, Peppermint, Rose Absolute, Musk, Cinnamon Bark, Blond Leather, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, White Wood and Amber Ketal.
